text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
WHEAT SALE - Two Philippine mills bought 100,000 tonnes of hard and soft Canadian wheat, Manila grains traders said.

WHEAT/CORN TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission issued tenders for a combined shipment of 14,000 of spring wheat and 8,000 tonnes of durum wheat for September shipment. It was also seeking 18,000 tonnes of corn due for September shipment.
CORN TENDER - Taiwanese importers are expected to tender for up to 108,000 tonnes of corn this week as buyers are apprehensive about a rise in futures prices on CBOT.

SOYBEAN TENDER - Taiwan is seen tendering for 54,000 tonnes of soybeans this week as buyers scramble to cover their positions on expectations of a rally in Chicago Board of Trade soy futures, dealers said.

WHEAT TENDERS - Jordan is tendering on August 12 for 100,000tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat. One shipment of 50,000 tonnes is for October delivery and the rest for November, European traders said.
WHEAT TENDERS - Morocco may have cancelled its 120,000 tonnes tender of optional origin wheat, several U.S. exporters said.
"I think what happened is they they passed on the go around and then they cancelled. That is the trade talk," one U.S. exporter said.
Another U.S. wheat exporter said Morocco passed due to price. "They just think (the price) will go lower," he said.
On July 29, Morocco launched a tender to buy 120,000 tonnes of optional wheat to be delivered in August and September, European traders said. Offers were due August 4.
WHEAT TENDERS - Iraq is in the world grain market with a tender for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for August or September, European grain traders said.

- The CCC was seeking up to 6,500 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Armenia and 6,500 tonnes of U.S. HRW wheat for donation to Georgia. Shipment was slated Aug 20-Sept 8. Offers are due Aug 5.

Armenia was also seeking about 1,000 to 1,500 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better HRW wheat in bulk under the PL-480, Title I export program, its U.S. export agent said. Delivery dates were set for Aug 20-Sept 8 and offers were due Aug 5.

VEGOIL TENDERS - Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries was seeking on August 19 10,000 to 20,000 tonnes of crude sunflower and/or semi-refined cottonseed oil for delivery in the second half of September.

MARKET TALK - South African shipping sources said on Mondaythat over 700,000 tonnes of this season's maize had left the country for abroad up until the end of July, the bulk of it white grain. However, small amounts of yellow maize -- used for animal feed -- had been shipped to the Middle East and more was expected to arrive in harbour soon.

... European grain traders bid through France on Friday for 722,500 tonnes of European Union soft wheat export at a standing export tax of 0.5 Ecus per tonne, cereals office ONIC said. They also sought licences for 9,000 tonnes of durum wheat at a fixed export tax of five Ecus, an ONIC official said.

... Recent rallies in Chicago soybean and corn futures have curbed China's buying interest and Chinese buyers were expected to remain sidelined until the market corrects, mainland traders said on Monday. "Chinese buyers are highly price-sensitive and they will not rush to buy any soybeans or corn during a rally," a China-based U.S. trader said. "There needs to be a large correction to lure Chinese buyers back into the market now," he added.
... Manila grains buyers are expected to sit out of the market this week as they wait for the peso to steady, traders said.
